# 1572. Matrix Diagonal Sum

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def diagonalSum(self, mat):
        """
        :type mat: List[List[int]]
        :rtype: int
        """
        n = len(mat)
        ans = 0
        for i in range(n):
            ans += mat[i][i]
        for i in range(n):
            ans += mat[i][n - 1 - i]
        if n % 2 == 1:
            ans -= mat[n // 2][n // 2]
        return ans
```
